fields.acceptance: The import topic states the one-record-per-area rule, the statement and acceptance rules and the follow-up anchoring step; a testscript follows those steps on a small fixture repo with tests and gets one landed record change set per area, every capability with a statement and an acceptance naming a test file, then a follow-up change set whose anchors are linked implements to those capabilities, and rhiza check passes.
fields.statement: The import procedure records what a repo already does as record change sets, one per area, whose capabilities each state one user-visible behaviour and give as acceptance the repo's existing tests that prove it, then anchors each area's capabilities to the code that implements them in a follow-up change set with rhiza add anchor.
